story.title: My Story
story.intro: A path of constant evolution: from writing my first lines of code to leading the digital transformation of a corporate group.
story.2020.desc: My starting point. I built web platforms with PHP/Laravel for massive student data management. Here I discovered that the most valuable code is the one that solves real problems.
story.2021.desc: I took the leap to build a proprietary B2B ERP. I immersed myself in understanding the real operations of companies to translate their physical processes into scalable APIs and efficient software flows.
story.2023.desc: Evolving from developer to technology leader. I led the complete digitalization: from paper-based processes to a 100% digital ecosystem with Odoo ERP, e-commerce integrations, and AI agents.

services.erp.desc: Operational process auditing, Odoo implementation and customization (v14–v18), and end-to-end digitalization strategy design.
